items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: raised Erskine and his brother Charles.

ctx.x: He would talk about how he
raised Erskine and his brother Charles. His brother Charles played trumpet, and Erskine played violin, and how he used to take him to recitals and how good they were and he would brag about them.

When they moved to Chicago, he separated from their mother. He wasn't the father of these kids, he was just the step-father; he married their mother. She had her own music school and he had his own music school.
